books-every-country.issue_summary: The current publication has 208 country/literary-region sections, 624 local positions and 617 distinct works. Of 1,395 retained source records, only 12 are currently eligible, all Wikipedia extracts; only eight sections link any of these, while 200 have no eligible linked source. The 12 records are section-level context, not proof of every associated book or local rank.
tasks: Audit all 208 sections separately. Preserve the supplied countries/literary regions and local rank 1–3 structure; return a complete revised section table with the same stable section identifiers and an explanation for any proposed boundary or naming change.

Use each section's full existing source bundle as the starting point. Locate and read substantive originals behind the 1,383 search/metadata leads; retain failed or unavailable leads with an honest status. Do not treat all 1,395 links as consulted evidence.

Map sources to specific works, country affiliation, inclusion and comparative local placement. Explain when a source supports only identity or literary context. Wikipedia extracts alone do not establish a top-three consensus.

Seek relevant local-language criticism, national literary institutions, published canons, anthologies, prizes and established lists, especially for the 200 sections without currently eligible evidence; record dependencies among copied lists.

Reassess the existing ESTABLISHED, PROVISIONAL and LIMITED confidence labels from actual evidence. Keep a provisional third choice or an explicit unresolved position where support is thin; do not fabricate confidence or silently delete a country to obtain a cleaner result.

Preserve cross-country recurrence through one work identity with multiple section placements. Distinguish diaspora, colonial, linguistic and disputed affiliations in explanatory notes, and retain collective or anonymous attribution without inventing authors.
books-every-country.desired_scope: Top three books/works within each of the existing 208 country or literary-region sections, aiming to preserve the breadth of 624 local placements as evidence permits. This is a grouped collection of country-level comparisons, never a global 1–624 merit ranking. English availability is useful metadata, not a universal eligibility requirement.
